description: This file defines the LanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, providing REST API endpoints for managing language entities, including CRUD operations such as getOne, getAll, create, update, and delete. It handles request validation, interacts with the LanguageService, and specifies OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing language resources, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and interacting with the LanguageService.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LanguageService instance used to perform CRUD operations on Language entities.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Language record by its ID and returns it as a LanguageModel wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Language records with support for sorting and pagination, returning an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Language entity based on request data and returns the created model.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Updates the Language entity with data from the request and saves it via the LanguageService.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Language by ID with data from the request and returns the updated model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules ensuring the ID parameter for getOne is positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing endpoints, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new Language entity, primarily validating the 'name' parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a Language, including ensuring ID is positive and that the name is unique.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' parameter, including length and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes language records given their IDs, returning the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation, primarily validating the list of IDs.
